messages:
maria: Quick proposal: unpin runtime 2.14 from llama3q canary and roll runtime 2.14.1 this Friday 10:00 UTC. 2.14.1 contains a batching kernel fix and a KV-cache mode default change.
release-coordinator: Need a short impact checklist + explicit rollback plan. Any contract/API changes?
tim: No external API changes. Internal change toggles a new KV mode flag `enable_kv_v2` to true by default in 2.14.1. Most SDKs are fine, but very old pinned SDKs that rely on cache keys might see differences.
maria: Rollout plan: staged canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 30m observation windows. Auto-rollback on error-rate or token-latency SLO breach. Manual rollback command documented.
ashley: Suggested guardrails: rollback if error-rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m; rollback if p50 token latency increases > 120ms; abort on any 5xx spike. Add a short sampling trace at token level to check KV parity.
raj: Pre-flight checks: run smoke + embedding consistency + chat-turn diff against the canary pool. Local commands: ```make smoke-test CANARY_POOL=llama3q-canary``` ```scripts/test_embedding_consistency.sh --pool llama3q-canary``` ```scripts/chat_turn_diff.sh --pool llama3q-canary --goldset quick``` Also add the new sampling harness: ```tools/sample_kv_parity --pool llama3q-canary --n 1000```
maria: I'll open a pinlist PR with the minimal diff. Snippet: ```- canary_pools:\n-  - runtime: 2.14\n+ canary_pools:\n+  - runtime: 2.14.1```
tim: SDK owners (cc @ashley @maria @tim) please run SDK CI against the runtime 2.14.1 canary. If any SDK test fails, we hold the rollout.
sre-oncall: I'll create an alert `canary-kernel-regression` scoped to llama3q-canary and a temporary dashboard. I'll also sanity-check autoscaler behavior during 50%->100% to catch OOM flaps.
deploy-bot: scheduled rollout for 1939104000 (Fri 10:00 UTC). Staged percentages: 10, 50, 100. Auto-rollback thresholds set per request.
maria: Pre-roll checklist: [x] smoke tests local green, [x] SDK CI queued, [x] canary alerts provisioned, [ ] pinlist PR merged.
ashley: Add a token-sampling trace and a short fuzz test for prefix stability. If parity drops below 99.9% we pause.
release-coordinator: Draft release-note blurb: "runtime 2.14.1 — batching kernel fix; KV-cache default migration to enable_kv_v2. No public API changes expected, but legacy SDKs may see cache-key diffs." Include known-risk section about SDK pinning.
maria: Manual rollback command if needed: ```deployctl rollback --env canary --from runtime:2.14.1 --to runtime:2.14 --reason "regression"```
deploy-bot: rollout started: canary 10% -> event ts 1939104600
deploy-bot: canary 10% complete; metrics snapshot: p50 token latency +11ms, error-rate 0.11%, 5xx 0.00%
maria: Observability check: token-level sampler parity 99.985% over 10k samples, traces look normal. Proceeding to 50% in 30m unless objections.
ashley: :thumbsup: proceed to 50% after window.
raj: Running additional embedding-consistency sweep and chat-turn quick goldset.
tim: If 24h stable and SDK CI remains green, plan to promote to Dedicated in next maintenance window.
release-coordinator: Decision recorded: proceed with staged unpin and promote after 24h of stable metrics. Action items: merge pinlist PR after 50% green, publish release notes, and follow-up with a short post-roll health check.
maria: Will merge pinlist PR once 50% is healthy and tag SDK owners for final signoff. Thanks all."
